messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they want to compute the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test given sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They might want to compute the standard error or the t-statistic? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" could refer to the standard error of the mean under the null hypothesis. That would be sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40) ≈ 6.3249. 1.4 / 6.3249 ≈ 0.2215. So the standard error is about 0.2215. Then the t-statistic would be (sample_mean - population_mean) / SE = (98.2 - 98.6) / 0.2215 = -0.4 / 0.2215 ≈ -1.805. But the user didn't ask for t-statistic. They asked for "標準差" for the null hypothesis test. That likely means the standard error. So we can provide that.

But the user might also want to compute the p-value? They didn't ask for p-value. They just want the standard deviation for the null hypothesis test. So we can give the standard error.

We can also mention that the standard error is 0.2215. And if they want the t-statistic, it's -1.805. But we can keep it simple.

We should respond in Chinese.
